text_en: The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel:
text_cn: 以色列王达味之子撒罗满的箴言：

text_en: For learning about wisdom and instruction, for understanding words of insight,
text_cn: 是为教人学习智慧和规律，叫人明了哲言，

text_en: for gaining instruction in wise dealing, righteousness, justice, and equity;
text_cn: 接受明智的教训─仁义、公平和正直，

text_en: to teach shrewdness to the simple, knowledge and prudence to the young—
text_cn: 使无知者获得聪明，使年少者获得知识和慎重，

text_en: let the wise also hear and gain in learning, and the discerning acquire skill,
text_cn: 使智慧者听了，增加学识；使明达人听了，汲取智谋，

text_en: to understand a proverb and a figure, the words of the wise and their riddles.
text_cn: 好能明了箴言和譬喻，明了智者的言论和他们的隐语。

text_en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge; fools despise wisdom and instruction.
text_cn: 敬畏上主是智慧的肇基； 只有愚昧人蔑视智慧和规律。

text_en: Hear, my child, your father’s instruction, and do not reject your mother’s teaching;
text_cn: 我儿，你应听你父亲的教训，不要拒绝你母亲的指教，

text_en: for they are a fair garland for your head, and pendants for your neck.
text_cn: 因为这就是你头上的冠冕，你颈上的珠链。

text_en: My child, if sinners entice you, do not consent.
text_cn: 我儿，如果恶人勾引你，你不要听从；

text_en: If they say, “Come with us, let us lie in wait for blood; let us wantonly ambush the innocent;
text_cn: 如果他们说：“来跟我们去暗算某人，无故地陷害无辜。

text_en: like Sheol let us swallow them alive and whole, like those who go down to the Pit.
text_cn: 我们要像阴府一样活活地吞下他们，把他们整个吞下去，有如堕入深坑里的人；

text_en: We shall find all kinds of costly things; we shall fill our houses with booty.
text_cn: 这样，我们必获得各种珍宝，以赃物充满我们的房屋。

text_en: Throw in your lot among us; we will all have one purse”—
text_cn: 你将与我们平分秋色，我们将共有同一钱囊。”

text_en: my child, do not walk in their way, keep your foot from their paths;
text_cn: 我儿，你不要与他们同流合污，该使你的脚远离他们的道路，

text_en: for their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed blood.
text_cn: 因为他们双脚趋向凶恶，急于倾流人血。

text_en: For in vain is the net baited while the bird is looking on;
text_cn: 在一切飞鸟眼前，张设罗网，尽属徒劳。

text_en: yet they lie in wait—to kill themselves! and set an ambush—for their own lives!
text_cn: 其实，他们不外是自流己血，自害己命。

text_en: Such is the end of all who are greedy for gain; it takes away the life of its possessors.
text_cn: 这就是谋财害命者的末路︰他必要送掉自己的性命。

text_en: Wisdom cries out in the street; in the squares she raises her voice.
text_cn: 智慧在街上呐喊，在通衢发出呼声；

text_en: At the busiest corner she cries out; at the entrance of the city gates she speaks:
text_cn: 在热闹的街头呼唤，在城门和市区发表言论︰

text_en: “How long, O simple ones, will you love being simple? How long will scoffers delight in their scoffing and fools hate knowledge?
text_cn: “无知的人，你们喜爱无知；轻狂的人，你们乐意轻狂；愚昧的人，你们憎恨知识，要到何时呢？

text_en: Give heed to my reproof; I will pour out my thoughts to you; I will make my words known to you.
text_cn: 你们应回心听我的劝告。看，我要向你们倾吐我的心意，使你们了解我的言词。

text_en: Because I have called and you refused, have stretched out my hand and no one heeded,
text_cn: 但是，我呼唤了，你们竟予以拒绝；我伸出了手，谁也没有理会。

text_en: and because you have ignored all my counsel and would have none of my reproof,
text_cn: 你们既蔑视了我的劝告，没有接受我的忠言；

text_en: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when panic strikes you,
text_cn: 因此，你们遭遇不幸时，我也付之一笑；灾难临到你们身上时，我也一笑置之。

text_en: when panic strikes you like a storm, and your calamity comes like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come upon you.
text_cn: 当灾难如暴风似的袭击你们，祸害如旋风似的卷去你们，困苦忧患来侵袭你们时，我也置之不顾。

text_en: Then they will call upon me, but I will not answer; they will seek me diligently, but will not find me.
text_cn: 那时，他们呼求我，我必不答应；他们寻找我，必寻不着我；

text_en: Because they hated knowledge and did not choose the fear of the Lord ,
text_cn: 因为他们憎恨知识，没有拣选敬畏上主，

text_en: would have none of my counsel, and despised all my reproof,
text_cn: 没有接受我的劝告，且轻视了我的一切规谏。

text_en: therefore they shall eat the fruit of their way and be sated with their own devices.
text_cn: 所以他们必要自食其果，饱尝独断独行的滋味。

text_en: For waywardness kills the simple, and the complacency of fools destroys them;
text_cn: 的确，无知者的执迷不悟杀害了自己；愚昧人的漠不关心断送了自己。

text_en: but those who listen to me will be secure and will live at ease, without dread of disaster. ”
text_cn: 但是，那听从我的，必得安居，不怕灾祸，安享太平。”
